items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate per Levitan; questionable after Friday limited practice, impacts Herbert and LAC projections heavily (4pm ET start).
items.why: Ribs; missed early practices, returned limited Friday.
items.implication: Monitor closely; if out, LAC WR/TE and Herbert projections shift.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Quentin Johnston and other LAC pass-catchers gain routes/targets.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Sunday vs CIN after missing practices; confirmed across ETR Sunday injury list and insider reports.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP week, official OUT designation.
items.implication: HOU WR room thins; stream TE/WR volume options.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Ja'Kobi Lane listed OUT or DOUBTFUL on ETR Sunday list; Flowers doubtful after limited/missed practices.
items.why: Hamstring; missed early practices, doubtful designation.
items.implication: Prepare without Flowers; BAL WR hierarchy thins to crumbs.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for remaining BAL receivers/TE.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee) OUT or DOUBTFUL on ETR list after limited Friday return; Raiders list doubtful.
items.why: Knee (post-meniscus); practiced limited Friday but doubtful.
items.implication: Sit Bowers; look to backup TE volume.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN; Levitan asks if Patriots give him 10+ touches in 2026 debut amid desperate need for playmakers (AJ Brown IR, Stevenson present). Nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready to go; Pats thin at skill with Brown on IR.
items.implication: Potential RB flex/handcuff upside with 10+ touch path.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, explosive plays vs Stevenson split; role expansion.

items.text: Levitan giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status matters for SF RB shares.
items.why: Strong Week 1 usage; Black groin status secondary.
items.implication: CMC remains elite start with potential full workload.
items.opportunity: Snaps, carries, targets, RZ if Black limited.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN on ETR Sunday injuries; expected back, further squeezing NO backfield.
items.why: Return from absence; ETR IN designation.
items.implication: Committee squeeze for Etienne/Miller; Kamara reclaims work.
items.opportunity: Kamara snaps/targets/RZ; reverse prior Etienne beneficiaries.

items.text: Joe Burrow (back) QUESTIONABLE but said he's playing; ETR notes and Schefter corroborate listing.
items.why: Back injury; self-reported playing, coach positive.
items.implication: Start Burrow if active; CIN offense intact vs HOU.
items.opportunity: Full Burrow usage if cleared; Chase/Higgins benefit.

items.text: AJ Brown listed OUT or DOUBTFUL (IR/return context) on ETR; Pats thin at WR playmakers.
items.implication: NE WR crumbs; boosts other Pats skill usage.
items.opportunity: Henderson and remaining NE pass-catchers elevated.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead), Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage/target share + soft matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; massive season upside if healthy.

items.text: Berry LOVES Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization (tied Bijan lead), 19% target share last 10, 25+ touches 3/4 recent.
items.why: Dominant utilization and receiving role under Kubiak.
items.implication: RB1 upside start; overreaction to prior injury scare.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util, 26% target share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell; CLE soft vs run.
Berry HATES Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Miller rushes W1, 69% points via air; Kamara back squeezes passing role, underdog script.
items.why: Committee with Kamara return + poor script.

items.text: Berry LOVES Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1, 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz; Bears soft vs WR.
